notes: Direct translation of the official English approved edited edition dated December1,2018, edited by Roel Baars and approved by the main organizers. The51 source pages include the original unchanged CC BY-NC-SA license cover.
The Taiwan91-page bilingual original is retained separately as a source reference and is not silently mixed into this approved English edition.
Original quantitative data, native formulas, statement labels and embedded True/False answer boxes must be retained. No separate blank answer sheet is asserted from the question-paper tables.
Q18 captionB prints Anablebs whereas other occurrences print Anableps; the original approved-edition spelling is retained rather than silently unified.
Q25 introduction prints infusoriform larva whereas statementA prints infusiform; both source forms are retained.

Q27 uses the source spelling plargonidin; Korean gives the standard pigment name with the original Latin spelling explicitly identified in parentheses. Figure structures and pigment numbers are unchanged.

Q35 statementB says ingestion in the approved English source; Korean preserves this as 섭취 and does not silently replace it with digestion. All True/False statements remain questions, not editorially corrected biological claims.
